findings.title: Keep the counting-rod interpretation distinct from direct numeral use
findings.details: The current learner overview says early forms were marks used directly for “four,” then describes the counting-rod explanation as disputed. The supplied round-3 readability review rejected that framing and required the counting-rod account to be presented as a proposal alongside the separate 呬 and 泗 borrowing proposals. Do not treat a rejected review suggestion as proof of a source error; the material issue is the wording in the current article and its unresolved review state.
findings.verification: Check the current article and final review receipts after revision. Confirm the learner overview labels the counting-rod reading as a proposal, distinguishes it from the 呬 and 泗 borrowing accounts, and has fresh factual and readability approval for the resulting article hash.
